messages:
andrew: heads-up — onboarding atlas-lite-70b (quant8-v2). Quick smoke shows output drift when context > ~34k tokens. Suspect KV index wrap / RoPE index mapping issue.

Tessa: can you paste the smallest repro and any logs? which kernel/runtime are you on? :thinking:

andrew: minimal repro below — super short:
```python
# repro snippet
resp = client.generate(model='atlas-lite-70b-quant8-v2', prompt='A'*35000, max_tokens=10)
print(resp.text[-80:])
```
On fp16 the tail is "...context end: OK" but on quant8 it becomes "...context end: MISMATCH" starting at token ~34012.
Logs around failure: 
```
KVCACHE: insert_idx=34012 shard=1
KVCACHE: read_idx=34012 -> mapped_idx=128
```
mapped_idx suddenly small (wrap).

cheng: hmm. Which runtime flags? continuous batching? batch size? I vaguely remember an int-cast bug with quant kernels.

andrew: continuous=True, batch=1, runtime=single-shard quant kernel v2 (int8 index math). Local quick test reproduces when window=32768. If window smaller it sometimes passes.

sofia: ops-bot log shows kernel deploy a few hours ago, might be related. @infra-team FYI.

ops-bot: deploy-hook: deployed inference-kernel/2.9.1-quant8 at 2026-03-10T02:14:22Z :rocket:

Tessa: plan: 1) confirm repro on dedicated vs hosted 2) kv-dump at failure idx 3) try forcing 16-bit index mode in qkernel to see if cast is root cause. Can you run kv-dump and paste a small slice?

andrew: ran kv-dump and truncated hex: 
```
0x00000840: ff ff ff 00 01 02 03 04 05 06 07 08 09 0a 0b 0c
0x00000850: 80 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 01 00 00 00 00 00 00 00
```
looks like a high bit / sign issue in the pointer/index entry.

cheng: ok that matches pointer overflow / negative index interpretation. Hypothesis: RoPE scale or position mapping uses signed 32 multipliers; combined with quantized index math we get negative intermediate that wraps when cast to unsigned. I can try a small clamp patch: if (mapped_idx < 0) mapped_idx += window_size.

Tessa: if patch is trivial, we can cut a hotfix canary. Also add a unit test that sweeps window sizes [16384, 32768, 65536] and offsets around multiples of 4096 to catch edge cases.

andrew: prepping a tiny PR with repro and kv-dump artifacts + unit. Will attach bench.

sofia: tagging infra for canary rollout @infra-team (and noting customer-facing cohorts for Dedicated).

andrew: quick bench (local, batch=1):
- fp16: stable across 100 runs
- quant8-v2 w/o patch: reproducible mismatch @34012 (100%)
- quant8-v2 with clamp patch: no mismatch in 1k runs, negligible perf impact (~0.2% latency)

Tessa: nice. Add to onboarding checklist: "long-context KV-wrap regression test" and require kv-dump artifact on any longctx failure.

andrew: PR created: #10234 with repro, unit, and patch. CI running. :+1:

ops-bot: PR 10234 created by andrew: https://git.redwood/infra/10234 :github:

cheng: ping me when CI green, i'll run canary on a handful of dedicated nodes (include a quantized and fp16 baseline).

andrew: thanks — will follow up with canary link and perf numbers.

sofia: also note in onboarding doc we should include a short troubleshooting section: "if mapped_idx resets near 0, check qkernel index cast + RoPE multiplier overflow".

andrew: adding that to the PR description. Thanks everyone."
